note: A RockSim file's deployment settings are now read. Nothing had ever read them, so every recovery device fell back to the default trigger and a dual-deploy design flew with drogue and main opening together at ejection - not the rocket the file describes. The drogue now opens at apogee and the main at the height the file names; re-open any dual-deploy .rkt, because its descent, drift and flight time all change. Separately, every Fruity Chutes canopy now carries the manufacturer's own published data including the spill hole, and a canopy's drag coefficient and spill hole travel together because the published Cd is measured against the canopy area minus the vent - with both, the app agrees with Fruity Chutes' own descent-rate calculator to about a part in a thousand. The Classic Elliptical rows read Cd 1.5 (their figure) in place of 1.55, the 96 inch Iris Ultra Compact's mass is fixed from 46 g to 425 g, and 26 missing canopies were added. Re-pick any Fruity Chutes canopy in an existing design.
